answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the relic bond on all of them and exposing each to the lagoon slash. Because the inlet audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Collateral of 19 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
